scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a few weeks ago and I'm eager to know if there's any update. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: I can certainly help with that. Your application has been approved, and the loan has been purchased by another institution. Is there anything else you would like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me what the interest rate is and the total costs associated with this loan? Also, I'm curious if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 7.375%. The record does not include total loan costs. There are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. What is the loan term? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 360 months. Yes, your loan has been purchased by another institution.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me what type of loan product I was approved for? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product. The record does not include a debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user:
I understand. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know.

<Neutral> The agent provided the information I needed, but I wish I had more details about the total costs and my debt-to-income ratio. It would have been helpful to have a clearer picture of the financial implications.
